title: FilterPreset
description: User-scoped filter-stack preset (app-data presets/*.json). Palette refs by id only — no embedded colors. Export format/DPI/paths are not stored.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (ISO-8601 preferred; unix seconds accepted).

items.description: Same shape as document.json FilterInstanceFile (algorithm_id + params).

palette_ids.description: Palette ids referenced by filter params (not embedded bytes).
